overview: The Royal Treasury Vaults safeguard Shar Vahl’s ceremonial wealth, clan tribute, and arcane‑sealed valuables.
history: The vaults were built beneath the palace to secure clan tribute and royal coin reserves.
Ceremonial lockboxes were added to store ritual valuables.
Arcane seals were introduced to protect sensitive items.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the vaults were expanded with reinforced chambers.
Shadow‑Threat Watch monitors the vaults for arcane anomalies.
hooks: A ceremonial lockbox destabilizes, threatening valuable contents.
A coin‑counting hall experiences a hazardous surge.
A clan tribute crate goes missing.
An arcane‑sealed vault shows signs of breach.
